thoughts.text: you pace for a while. your thoughts are scattered
you sit on your couch and are consumed by anxious thoughts
you start thinking about the woods and recoil
there is a memory around you. you feel at once you are a child and shudder
a laugh, echoing from some distant place
why do you accept being so alone?
you wish your computer was fixed
one time someone asked you if you had any skills
a voice, strong and wise, coming from the kitchen
